_doc: Posting slots (America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires). The publisher schedules each post in Buffer with mode customScheduled at the next free slot of its platform. TikTok slots are 4 h apart (rule R2 needs >= 3 h). Change times here only; Analista may propose new slots from audience data. The same slots are set as Buffer posting schedules (queue), so addToQueue also lands on them.
